rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2.2-2.4 - ~700 topsoil (0-10 cm) samples collected at 100 grid points every two days over one 10-day drip irrigation cycle (10-20 July 2014) and in three seasons in the saline-drip-irrigated Taklimakan Highway Shelterbelt, analysed for moisture, EC and other properties with geostatistics. Q2: Section 3.2.1, Figures 3-5 and Abstract - under saline drip irrigation (4.8 g/L) soil moisture in the topsoil was highest on day 2 and fell to its lowest by day 8, while EC rose from day 2 to day 6 then fell at day 8 and rose again at day 10 (rain); Section 3.2.2/Figure 8 - salinity rose slightly from spring to summer/autumn and long-term saline drip irrigation increased topsoil salinity slightly.
rows.notes: The specific figures in the passage (moisture 26.4%-2.7%, EC 0.70-3.99 dS/m for a 10-day cycle) do not appear in this study: here topsoil moisture ranged 0-10% (mean 1.19%) and EC 0.09-11.46 mS/cm (mean 1.56), and EC did not rise monotonically over the cycle (increase to day 6, then decrease, then rise after rain). Those numbers presumably come from the co-cited reference [58]. The study nonetheless gives its own field evidence that topsoil moisture declines and salinity tends to concentrate under saline drip irrigation within a cycle. Q3: single method (soil cores, oven drying, 1:5 EC). Q4: evaporation/capillary rise and lateral seepage mechanisms are asserted, not measured; soil moisture was measured alongside EC but not analysed as the pathway. Q5/Q6: one site, one Aeolian sandy soil, field-scale grid only. Q7: texture-EC correlation reported but not stated as a requirement. Q8: authors note that unexpected rain confounded the day-10 measurement, but no explicit limitation of the result is stated; point-scale/0-10 cm only not flagged. Q9: Table 1 gives SD and range for moisture and EC pooled over all samples, not for the within-cycle change; no error bars reported for Figure 4/8.

notes: Full text appears complete. Study is a single-site geostatistical field survey of topsoil moisture and EC under saline groundwater drip irrigation in a desert shelterbelt; it supports the general pattern claimed but not the specific numbers in the passage.
